_meta.sampling_method: NONE — full concept lattice (314 rows: 218 fact_category + 77 dark_table + 19 signal_class) and full tool census (118 capabilities) are included verbatim, not sampled. Edge extraction is a mechanical regex scan (marsys:// URI pattern) over each concept row's served_basis prose field — an honest, inspectable heuristic, not an AST/import-graph resolution; it will miss a serving relationship if the source prose does not literally name the tool URI.
